description:
After 25 years of restoring cars in his garage, Rob Howard realized the traditional restoration model was broken. Most vintage builds lack reliability and a service network, leaving owners frustrated. To fix this, Kindred applies a standardized production model where every vintage icon—from the 1966-1977 Bronco to the 1954-1968 VW Bus—is stripped to the frame and rebuilt using a repeatable process that prioritizes 1,400 hours of human craftsmanship over robotics. Vehicles retain their original VIN and chain of custody while gaining modern tech and reliability, fulfilling Howard’s vision of making these classic cars truly immortal.

With pricing for the gasoline Bronco starting at $199,000 and the EV variant at approximately $225,000, Kindred seamlessly integrates contemporary luxuries like high-fidelity audio and USB connectivity into a curated vintage aesthetic. title: Beyond the Restomod: How Kindred Motorworks Builds "Immortal" Classics | Cars & Bikes | Forbes

author: Forbes
description:
After leaving "The Voice" and taking a break from recording, country superstar Blake Shelton is back with a Las Vegas residency and a growing restaurant empire. But he would much rather be at home on the range.

In many ways, Shelton’s career has been defined by the tug-of-war between show business and the life of hunting, fishing and farming he prefers in Tishomingo, Oklahoma, where he lives on a sprawling ranch with his wife, pop star Gwen Stefani. “I don’t even care if I miss an opportunity by not responding to a text or a phone call,” he says of his time there. “It’s really the only way I can maintain some sanity.” 

The 49-year-old country music superstar describes all his ventures with similar aw-shucks humility. title: The Real Reason Blake Shelton Quit 'The Voice' After 23 Seasons
